edits.new: Where the run records are read from, how long they are kept and which retention the schedule history of the `rwb-recovery` namespace carries are settled here: the run records are read through the P1 admin path, and the Schedule ID, the catch-up and backfill rule and the run-record retention are those of the schedule catalog published with RWB-PLT-E1071-CON. rwb-decision publishes the ingest completeness state of each business date, and Compliance is told through the ACE notification path for the three reports. Chain-check scope and reporting route are recorded by assumption ASM-B-ITG-W1-10-TE008-1: the Schedule lives in rwb-decision, checks the central ledger and every wave-1 local chain, and reports the first break per chain with `MSG-P7-008`, raising one incident. The ingest watermark and its 04:00 latest start are recorded by ASM-B-ITG-W1-10-TE008-2. The working default is the workflow history of the Schedule plus the gateway-bff readiness view, with no new platform table (ASM-2530). Open decisions DL10 (ASM-2250, ASM-2357, ASM-2377, ASM-2863) and DL11 (ASM-0553, ASM-0703, ASM-1051, ASM-1104) remain open, each with its assumption.
